children: Australia's Hipages needs to improve revenue growth and Ebitda margin expansion if its stock is to rerate, Morgan Stanley analysts say. They tell clients in a note that Hipages, which operates a marketplace for consumers to engage with skilled tradespeople, is a well-run and profitable business. They say management is executing solidly on a strategic plan, but that risk return is not hugely attractive relative to other opportunities within Australian tech, media and telco. Customer wins and revenue growth have decelerated, they warn. MS ceases coverage of Hipages with an equal-weight recommendation on the stock, cutting target price by 3.8% to 0.75 Australian dollars. Shares are flat at A$0.845. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
